analogy.rationale: TPP2 is a cytosolic tripeptidyl peptidase that trims peptides for antigen presentation and turnover; its inhibition is unlikely to perturb the 978-gene transcriptional readout strongly in these cell lines, so the expected response is weak. Proteasome inhibition is the closest functional analog because it also blocks cytosolic peptide degradation, while translation/mTOR/HSP/protein-kinase inhibitors share only generic proteostasis stress.
